title: SE(3) 6-generator symmetry-transfer supplement
orientation_note: Q1 identity only (nominal insertion axis = world z). Roll/pitch are realized as genuine post-grasp re-orientations of the peg (not geometry-locked), and dw is the axial depth DOF. The tilt feasibility was established by the Phase-0 probe (se3_tilt_probe.csv): every +-15 deg tilt cell reaches circular_insert across all three seeds.
task_anchor_note: RE-ANCHORED from the SE(2) common anchor (-0.35, 0.10, 0.08). That anchor sits ~0.29 m from the Panda base; the bent-arm configuration constrains wrist orientation so combined tilt+translation+yaw align poses are IK-unsolvable (mixed-context failures at ~25-50%, deterministic for the roll=+8/pitch=-5/yaw=+12 corner which fails at align/lift). A full-box corner screen at (-0.15, 0.00, 0.08) confirmed 64/64 corners of the +-0.012 m / +-15 deg / +-30 deg box reachable across 2 seeds x 3 retries. Chosen from IK/collision feasibility only, never from Pdiag results.

keyed.solver: solve_se3 (full SE(3) post-grasp re-orientation to roll/pitch/yaw, then unlock yaw to 0)
keyed.note: yaw is the unique selective generator: alpha_yaw = 1 in align/enter, 0 in unlock/insert. du/dv/dw/roll/pitch are always-on during insertion.

circular_honest.solver: solve_se3 with align_yaw=0 (keep socket roll/pitch tilt, drop yaw)
circular_honest.note: full SO(2) yaw gauge symmetry: alpha_yaw = 0 everywhere. du/dv/dw/roll/pitch remain always-on.

oracle.note: The five non-yaw generators are 0 during reach/grasp/lift (peg at fixed pedestal) and 1 during insertion. yaw is the only generator that additionally drops to 0 at unlock (SO(2)->C2 gauge symmetry).

contexts.isolated_grid: du/dv/dw at +-0.015 m; roll/pitch at +-15 deg; yaw at +-15 and +-30 deg
contexts.demonstrations: N in {8, 15, 30} mixed demos, subsampled from the 60-mixed manifest via a FROZEN subset file (se3_subsets.json). N>=6 is required for a rank-6 design.
contexts.perturbation_tests: 14 held-out isolated interventions plus the zero baseline

frozen_model.finite_action: C0 Exp(P(s) Log(C0^-1 C)) C0^-1 X0 in SE(3), 6-dim diagonal

success_criteria.M4_selectivity_identification: HEADLINE. Delta_j = mean(alpha_j | phase<2) - mean(alpha_j | phase>=2). Oracle Delta*_yaw = 1, Delta*_others = 0. Correct iff Delta_yaw > 0.5 AND Delta_j < 0.5 for all of du/dv/dw/roll/pitch. Target ~100% for Pdiag finite across seeds/subsets at N in {8,15,30}.
success_criteria.M1_generator_identification_error: E_alpha(task; N, model) = (1/(6T)) sum_j sum_t (alpha_j(t) - alpha*_j^task(t))^2, summed over all 6 generators
success_criteria.M2_symmetry_discrimination_accuracy: classify fit as keyed iff alpha_yaw^pre > 0.5; target 100% for Pdiag finite at every N
success_criteria.M0_switch_fidelity: keyed arm reproduces the frozen 0.5-crossing transition location in the yaw channel

collection_policy.anchor_note: SE(3) supplement re-anchored to (-0.15, 0.00, 0.08); see task_anchor_note. The SE(2) common anchor (-0.35, 0.10, 0.08) is IK-limited for full 6D mixed contexts.
collection_policy.env_change_note: Two NEW @register_env classes (KeyedCircularPhaseSwitchSE3-v1 / CircularPhaseSwitchSE3-v1) were added; the frozen SE(2) classes and their provenance hashes are byte-for-byte preserved.
